capabilities: Build outfits by snapping clothing item images into configurable layer rows
Save a selected outfit as a Markdown note with image embeds
Filter which notes appear using configurable frontmatter properties
Assign untyped clothing notes to rows by updating their type property
Render saved outfits from default or custom Markdown templates
disambiguation: Not a theme or appearance manager; it builds clothing outfits from item notes.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; GPL-3.0-only license; runs locally with no network requests; output embeds link to image files, not clothing notes, so no backlinks are created between outfits and items.
problem: Obsidian has no visual way to compose and compare item images from notes; images sit as static embeds with no tool to assemble them into combinations.
summary: Visual outfit builder that arranges clothing item images into layered rows and saves combinations as Markdown notes with image embeds.
